items.prompt: If the permitted line-search trials are exhausted, what should this helper do?

options.text: Return the best-looking point as a certified optimum
Silently increase the trial budget forever
Keep the original iterate and report line-search-limit
options.why: The failure is explicit and the failed candidate is not committed.

options.text: Hide the failure by returning stationary
options.why: Stationary has a different mathematical meaning.

items.explanation: A bounded search needs an honest status and an unchanged iterate on failure in this helper contract.
